|gr1= GUI Control - Positioning

|descr= Sets scale of a control. Top left corner remains same. This command requires [[ctrlCommit]].

|s1= control [[ctrlSetScale]]  scale

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|p2= scale: [[Number]] - scale e.g. 2 = 200% in size

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_control ctrlSetScale 0.5;// Makes the control 50% smaller
_control ctrlCommit 0;
</sqf>
